BTC is the relative core holding, supported by liquidity and institutional factors, but its modest composite and conviction do not justify aggressive increases. ETH is fragile on near-zero composite with higher beta, volatility, and expected shortfall. SOL and LTC are clearly fragile: negative composite/alpha, weak institutional factors, and poor liquidity, with LTC the weakest on liquidity. Keep overall exposure reduced and avoid adding risk.
